title: Director, AI Productivity Product Lead
jd_excerpt:
About this role

About the Role
BlackRock’s Workplace AI organization shapes how employees across the firm use AI productivity tools in their daily work. Microsoft 365 Copilot is a core part of how our people work today, and its role is expanding quickly: from chat and in-app help to agentic, multi-step work through Copilot Cowork, agents built in Copilot Studio, and a growing ecosystem of connectors and plugins.

As the AI Productivity Product Lead, you are the single accountable leader for Copilot at BlackRock. You will own product strategy, roadmap and business outcomes across the full Copilot estate, lead a team of product managers covering employee experience, technical platform and business engagement, and serve as BlackRock’s senior product counterpart to Microsoft.

This role reports to the Head of AI Solutions.

What You Will Do

Product Strategy and Roadmap
• Set a multi-year product vision and strategy aligned to BlackRock’s Workplace AI direction and Copilot’s role in the firm’s broader AI toolset
• Own a single, outcome-based roadmap spanning the full Copilot suite, including Copilot Chat, Copilot in M365 apps, Copilot Cowork, agents and Autopilots, Copilot Studio, connectors and plugins
• Make deliberate decisions about what BlackRock adopts, when, and for whom, making clear “not yet” and “not for us” calls where value or readiness isn’t there
• Define where Copilot fits within BlackRock’s broader AI tool landscape so employees know which tool to use for which work

Business Value and Adoption
• Set success metrics such as active usage, depth of use, time saved and workflow outcomes, and report progress to senior leadership
• Identify and prioritize high-value, business-specific workflows across functions
• Create adoption targets and turn usage insights into product changes, enablement priorities and feature decisions

Vendor and Commercial Leadership
• Act as BlackRock’s senior product lead with Microsoft: influence roadmap priorities, escalate enterprise requirements and secure early access where it serves the firm
• Shape licensing strategy, seat allocation and consumption-based spend (e.g., Copilot Credits for Cowork and agents), ensuring cost is measured against value delivered

Governance, Risk and Controls
• Ensure every Copilot capability, model and release meets BlackRock's global requirements, partnering with AI governance, Information Security, Legal and Compliance, and AI enablement teams from design through launch
• Set product requirements for configuration, controls, connector and agent governance, and release readiness for each new capability

Team Leadership
• Lead, develop and grow a team of product managers, building a high-performance culture grounded in clear ownership and measurable outcomes
• Run product rhythms and decision forums and sequence priorities against delivery capacity

What You Bring

• 12+ years of experience in product management, digital workplace or enterprise technology, including 5+ years leading product teams
• Deep, hands-on knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Microsoft 365 Copilot, including Copilot Studio, agents, Power Platform and the M365 admin, security and compliance stack (e.g., Purview, Entra)
• Proven track record of scaling an enterprise AI or productivity product to a large, global employee population, with measurable adoption and business impact
• Working fluency in generative and agentic AI concepts (multi-model orchestration, grounding and retrieval, connectors, agent permissions and evaluation) sufficient to make sound product trade-offs with engineering
• Experience managing a strategic vendor relationship at a senior level, including roadmap influence
• Experience delivering technology in a regulated environment with strong risk, compliance and security requirements; financial services experience strongly preferred
• Exceptional executive communication: you simplify complexity, build a business case and drive decisions with senior stakeholders

For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$210,000.00 - USD$275,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
